description.value: Panda Island is a cozy family-run restaurant in Central Oak Bay, specializing in Guangdong-style cuisine with Western influences, led by head chef Wen. The kitchen emphasizes fresh ingredients and minimized oils, offering everything from quick on-the-go lunches to relaxed dine-in experiences. Delivery is available through DoorDash and SkipTheDishes, making it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through the Oak Bay Avenue corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active, family-run Chinese restaurant at 1950A Oak Bay Avenue in Oak Bay, Victoria. Takeout is explicitly offered ('place a pickup order, call us at (250) 595-3021'), and multiple menu items are noted as vegan or gluten-friendly on request. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere on the site.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple dishes can be made gluten-friendly (wheat-free and soy sauce-free) on request. Tofu Chop Suey (No. 8) can be made 'gluten-friendly and/or vegan upon request.' Hot & Sour Soup has a vegetarian version. Site notes they do not have a dedicated gluten-free kitchen and advises celiac customers to inquire
